basics.name: Anushree Ganta
basics.label: Full-Stack Web Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Web Developer with technical expertise in building open-source platforms, researcher dashboards, web experiments, and responsive web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js. Skilled in internationalization (i18n), WCAG accessibility, CMS integrations, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

work.name: Google (via GlobalLogic)
work.summary: Architected scalable web platforms, researcher/analytics dashboards, and automated PLM workflows powering Google's Global Supply Management operations in cross-functional Agile environments.
highlights: Architected modular open-source web platform features and researcher dashboards using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript, incorporating internationalization (i18n) and responsive design.
Engineered full-stack analytics dashboards and automated data pipelines (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, REST APIs), modernizing legacy infrastructure and boosting system reliability by 35%.

work.name: eDiligence
work.summary: Engineered interactive data visualization dashboards and modular client/server-side architectures to track real-time research and development metrics.
highlights: Architected an interactive analytics platform and researcher tools using React.js, Redux, and D3.js, visualizing complex telemetry data and experimental velocity with dynamic charts.
Designed component-driven UI libraries leveraging Material-UI (MUI), and built high-performance Node.js & Express REST APIs integrated with MongoDB schema optimization.

work.name: Accenture Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Spearheaded full-stack feature development, CMS module customization, UI component modularization, and web performance optimization for enterprise web platforms.
highlights: Engineered interactive analytics web pages and tools using React.js, Node.js, and clean SEO-friendly HTML5/CSS3 code, evaluating third-party modules for accessibility and maintainability.
Implemented Real User Monitoring (RUM) using Boomerang.js, analyzing Core Web Vitals to optimize page load speeds by 25% across diverse devices and browsers.

projects.name: Blink – Anonymous Workplace Community Platform
projects.description: An open-source, responsive full-stack web application for community discussions and real-time telemetry.
highlights: Architected an accessible, mobile-first web client using React.js, Redux, and CSS Grid with internationalization support and decoupled message queue middleware for real-time updates.

projects.name: Online Banking Web Application
projects.description: A secure, multi-role web application supporting real-time user workflows and data visualization.
highlights: Engineered customer and admin web portals in React.js and Node.js with WCAG accessibility standards, OAuth authentication, and low-latency API data processing.
